Tom —

Great to speak yesterday. I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align evaluation milestones and procurement windows for Dedicated / Private capacity. A few things we need from your side to finalize sizing and lead-time assumptions: 

- Target go-live date for production (approximate week is fine)
- Expected steady-state QPS or peak tokens/sec for the most latency-sensitive route
- Preferred hardware family (H100 vs A100) or openness to a hybrid approach

Rafael —

Thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers inline below: 

- Target go-live: target production week of 2027-01-10 (can slip 1–2 weeks)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novum MAP sizing options (internal)

Rafael / team —

I ran Novum’s CSV through our sizing model and put two scenarios in sizing_calc.xlsx (attached): conservative and aggressive. TL;DR:

- Conservative: 8 H100-equivalent nodes (4 reserved for staging/QA, 4 for prod burst), covers steady 60k tokens/sec with room for caching + batching.
- Aggressive: 12 H100-equivalent nodes (6 staging, 6 prod), headroom for 95k token bursts and 20% growth.

Private VPC lead times (estimates):
- Network kickoff to clearance: 7–10 business days (assuming standard firewall rules and a customer network engineer available)
- KMS/HSM integration: 5–7 business days
- SOC2 evidence gathering & review: 10–12 business days (depends on which artifacts Novum can provide immediately)
- Physical capacity provisioning for H100 on Private images: 6–8 weeks (sourcing + validation)

If Novum is willing to accept a hybrid: reserve core A100-backed Dedicated pool to guarantee baseline capacity (2–4 weeks lead) and slide H100 tranche for full PHI workload, we can accelerate initial onboarding and reduce risk to their Jan target.

Also flagged cost delta and ops tradeoffs in the sheet. If procurement needs a staged PO we can produce a pricing tranche for 4/6/12 node commitments to match their budget committee ask.

Attachment: sizing_calc.xlsx (xlsx)
Ben
Sr Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP: Novum Health capacity & evaluation timeline — proposed MAP and next steps

Tom / team —

Thanks for the details and the CSV. Based on our sizing models and internal capacity constraints, here’s a concise Mutual Action Plan and timeline to hit a staged commit by Dec 15 and a Jan 10 pilot: 

1) Nov 15–Nov 18 (this week) — Finalize MAP doc and confirm preferred sizing tranche (Novum to sign-off on conservative vs aggressive).
2) Nov 19–Nov 26 — Security & network kickoff (Novum to provide initial SOC2 artifacts; Redwood to schedule network handoff call).
3) Nov 29–Dec 9 — Procurement window: produce staged PO options (4-node staging tranche + 4/8 prod tranches); pricing/term sheet (Redwood).
4) Dec 10–Dec 20 — Provisioning & validation (if H100 tranche ordered, expect 6–8 weeks provisioning; expedite possible with hybrid Dedicated fallback).
5) Jan 04–Jan 10 — Pilot / smoke tests in Private VPC; go/no-go for production.

Gating items 
- SOC2 artifact package from Novum (App config + retention policy + audit contact)
- Network owner contact for firewall whitelisting and VPN setup
- Signed staged PO by Dec 15 to lock tranche allocation

Recommendation: to keep Jan 10 realistic, we propose a hybrid approach — immediate Dedicated A100-backed ephemeral tranche to validate routes and a scheduled H100 tranche for PHI traffic (delivered on the 6–8 week cadence). This reduces launch risk and keeps procurement comfortable with a staged commitment.

I’ve attached an updated MAP (Novum_MAP_v2.xlsx) with explicit milestones, acceptance criteria, and the 3 pricing tranches Ben suggested. Also linked the HubSpot opportunity and draft terms.

Next steps: please confirm which sizing tranche you want us to price (conservative vs aggressive) and share the SOC2 artifact contact; we’ll push a formal staged PO template by Monday Nov 16.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Attachment: Novum_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
